This cruise features a three and a half hour harbour and lake cruise and a full dinner buffet. Complimentary coffee & tea as well a cannon fire to celebrate the event. Join us on our Airshow Cruise, for an exciting afternoon of aerial acrobatics and stunning views of the city skyline onboard Canada’s largest sailing ship.
